Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Dr. B.P. Pal
rows.Origin: Bred by Indian Agric. Research Inst. IARI (India, 1980).
rows.Bloom: Purple. Solferino purple. Mild fragrance. 70 petals. Very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
